At resonance XL (inductive reactance) and XC (capacitive reactance) are equal and opposite, so they "cancel" each other out, making the overall impedance the pure ohmic resistance of the conductor itself. But we need power. free power for all. Power is the fusion (product) of two energy forms: Voltage (EMF) and Current.
